label: rem:lean-lib-hecke-temperley-lieb
title: Community Library 1 (HeckeTemperleyLieb): Iwahori--Hecke rewriting, Markov radicals, and Young--Hoefsmit representations
html:
HeckeTemperleyLieb packages the algebraic and representation-theoretic formalisation of type-A_{n-1} Iwahori--Hecke algebras H_n(q) (jones1987, wenzl1988) and their Temperley--Lieb quotients TL_n(q) as a standalone Mathlib4 extension:

  • Kang--Lee--Lee--Oh Gröbner--Shirshov normal forms (NotAGSBasis, HeckeAlgebra). Proves the explicit n = 4 counterexample establishing that the naive quadratic Hecke plus braid relations fail Diamond Lemma confluence on B_4^+, and formalises the completed Kang--Lee--Lee--Oh rewriting system (kangleeleeoh2002) together with single-pass normal forms for monotone Coxeter chains (SL2ChebyshevTrace).
  • Markov trace radical and Temperley--Lieb quotient (TemperleyLiebTower, BorromeanMarkovTrace). Constructs the Jones--Ocneanu Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M at loop weight z = q^3/(q^2+1), proves exact vanishing of the three-row Wedderburn weight y_{(1^3)} = 0 and Gram determinant \det G = 0 for n \ge 3, and establishes the radical isomorphism TL_n(q) \cong H_n(q)/\mathrm{rad}\,\tau_q of Catalan dimension C_n.
  • Young--Hoefsmit seminormal matrices and Schur elements (ProtonQ3SchurElement, CrossNucleonPairWedderburnZRemoval). Formalises standard Young tableaux axial distances, seminormal generator matrices (hoefsmit1974, ram1991), central characters \chi^\lambda, and hook-content Schur weights over \mathbb{Q}(q).
